title: Meals You Can't Miss
editorial: Delicious and decadent, food was our favourite part of Malaysia. It’s so hard to resist that Malaysia has the third-highest incidence of diabetes per capita! Nasi lemak, the national dish, is a divine experience.

Jalan Alor food street in Kuala Lumpur is accused of being a tourist trap, but we were drawn to it like moths to a flame. On one of the nights we spent here, we devoured mee goreng, cockles, oysters, frogs, beef satays, mango sticky rice, and matcha ice cream.
Good Timing Food Village in Jalan Alor was a spot we hit multiple times. In Langkawi, Yasmin serves phenomenal Syrian food. The lamb mandi was to die for!
